caption: The drawing depicts a collection of jewelry pieces arranged in a neat, symmetrical layout on a plain background. The items include a circular bracelet at the top center composed of alternating rectangular black and gold segments, joined by gold links, with a gold safety chain attached to one side. Flanking the bracelet on both the left and right are two identical straight bracelets, each consisting of a repeating pattern of small rectangular black sections framed in gold with gold links connecting them. Below the circular bracelet, there are four distinct rectangular elements: two golden yellow and two black, placed side by side with golden frames, forming a two-by-two grid. Directly above these rectangles are three small, geometric pieces (possibly clasps or decorative elements) in gold, rectangular and L-shaped forms. At the very bottom, there is a narrow horizontal strip made up of small, closely set black rectangles bordered by gold. The overall color palette of the drawing is dominated by gold, black, and shades of yellow, with clean lines and clear outlines for each object.
title: Onyx Bracelet
